{{Quote|You flea-bitten, snaggle-toothed vermin! Get out of our village!|Chief [[Chirpa/Legends|Chirpa]] to the [[Dulok/Legends|Duloks]]|<ref name="Blue Harvest" />}}
'''Fleas''' came in many forms across the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. One species found on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]] infested native lifeforms such as [[Dulok/Legends|Duloks]].<ref name="Blue Harvest">{{Ewoks|Blue Harvest}}</ref> Wild [[Greysor]]s of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] were often bothered by fleas.<ref name="Wildlife">''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]''</ref>

Other species included:
*[[Floater flea]]

*[[Lava flea]]
